answer_4.quote: We hired crowdworkers residing in the US to carry out the description annotation process through Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT).
answer_4.guideline: Workers are presented with descriptions categorized under the same face act as the utterance. For example, if workers annotate a description of the EE's utterance whose face act is categorized as hpos-, they annotate either 'EE doubts or criticizes STC or ER.' or 'EE either knows nothing about STC or is not interested in STC.' as the intention of the utterance.
